assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and atherosclerotic heart disease.
Diagnosis code G45.9 is associated with the patient's condition.
Diagnosis code I25.10 is associated with the patient's condition.
Diagnosis code I49.5 is associated with the patient's condition.
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion and to optimize rate control.
The payer denied the claim under Reason Code CO-197.
The denial reason indicates that the required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
